Terms.Label: Demand Provinces
Terms.Description: Take a number of provinces from the loser. Cost scales with the number of provinces taken.

Terms.Label: Annex Nation
Terms.Description: Fully annex the defeated nation and absorb its remaining industry.

Terms.Label: Puppet State
Terms.Description: Turn the defeated nation into a puppet. Its factories stay but its actions are controlled by the winner.

Terms.Label: Liberate Nation
Terms.Description: Release the defeated nation as an independent state that keeps its original territory.

Terms.Label: War Reparations
Terms.Description: Take civilian factories and political power from the loser as compensation.

Terms.Label: Demilitarize
Terms.Description: Force the loser to scrap military factories. Cheapest for the winner, lowers world tension.
